name: word-counter
description: Exact word, character, and sentence counts with essay and social-post limit checks.

interface.longDescription:
Zovo Word Counter gives exact counts for any text you paste into the chat: words, characters with and without spaces, letters, sentences, paragraphs, lines, and unique words. Every number comes from documented, deterministic rules instead of an estimate, so a 1,500-word essay limit or a 280-character post is checked precisely.

For students and academic writers: count words without citations. Zovo Word Counter can leave out APA and MLA in-text citations such as (Smith, 2020) or (Smith 23), quoted passages, headings, and the reference list or works cited, then shows how many words each exclusion removed. Check a minimum and maximum word count and see exactly where to cut.

For writers, speakers, and marketers: reading time at 238 words per minute, speaking time at 150 words per minute, Flesch reading ease and Flesch-Kincaid grade for English, top keywords with density, the longest sentence, and warnings for sentences over 25 and 40 words.

For social media and SEO: checks X (Twitter) posts with its weighted counting rules (every link counts as 23 characters, emoji and CJK characters count as 2), Threads (500), Bluesky (300 graphemes), LinkedIn posts (3,000), Instagram captions (2,200), SEO title tags (60), meta descriptions (155-160), and SMS messages (160 GSM-7 or 70 Unicode characters per segment, with the characters that force Unicode). When text is too long, it shows the last words that fit and how much to remove.

Works with English, Polish, German, Spanish, French, and other space-separated languages, and splits Japanese, Chinese, and Thai text into words, with CJK character counts.

Privacy: text is processed in memory only to compute the counts. It is not stored or logged, and results contain counts plus short excerpts (such as where to cut) rather than your full text.

Limitations: up to 100,000 characters per request; files such as PDF or Word documents cannot be opened directly, so paste the text. Citation and heading detection follows common APA and MLA patterns and may miss unusual formats. Readability scores are English-only estimates.
defaultPrompt: Count the words, excluding citations: Teens sleep less online (Smith & Jones, 2020). Late scrolling hurts rest (Lee, 2019).
Does this fit X's 280 and LinkedIn's 3,000 limits? "Big news! Our app is live 🚀 Try it at https://example.com/launch #startup"
How long to read this aloud? "Thank you all for coming tonight. Ten years ago we started with one idea and a tiny team."

positive.description: Essay word count without citations, headings, or the reference list
positive.prompt:
Count the words in my essay, excluding citations, headings and the reference list:

Introduction

Social media use among teenagers has grown rapidly over the past decade (Smith & Jones, 2020). Researchers argue that heavy use before bed is linked to shorter and poorer sleep, which in turn affects mood, attention, and school performance across several large studies (Lee et al., 2019, p. 12). However, Twenge (2017) notes that the effect sizes are small. As one student put it, "I check my phone before I even get out of bed." Schools can still help by teaching simple habits.

References
Lee, K., Park, J., & Kim, S. (2019). Sleep and screens. Journal of Youth Studies, 4(2), 10-20.
Smith, A., & Jones, B. (2020). Teens online. Academic Press.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls count_text with the essay verbatim and exclude_citations, exclude_headings, and exclude_reference_list set to true. Reports 73 words (109 before exclusions), 5 sentences, and that 2 citations (9 words, e.g. (Smith & Jones, 2020)), the heading Introduction, and the reference list (26 words) were left out. Flags 1 sentence over 25 words (27 words). The widget shows the word tile, keyword chips, and the long-sentence warning without repeating the full essay.

positive.description: X and LinkedIn limit check with a link and an emoji
positive.prompt: Does this post fit X's 280 limit and LinkedIn's 3,000 limit? "Big news! Our app is live 🚀 Try it at https://example.com/launch #startup"
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_length_limits with platforms x and linkedin. X counts 71 of 280 weighted characters (209 left) because the link counts as 23 and the emoji as 2; LinkedIn counts 73 of 3,000 characters (2,927 left). Both fit, shown as two green limit bars.

positive.description: Reading and speaking time for a speech
positive.prompt: How long will this toast take to say out loud? "Good evening, everyone, and thank you for being here tonight. Ten years ago, three of us sat around a kitchen table with a laptop, a whiteboard, and an idea that most people told us would never work. We wanted to make it easier for small businesses to get paid on time. Today, more than four thousand companies use what we built, and every one of them started with a single invoice. None of this happened because of one big moment. It happened because this team showed up every day, fixed what was broken, and listened to customers when it was hard to hear. So tonight is not about the past ten years. It is about the people in this room, and the next ten years we will build together. Please raise your glasses to the team, to our customers, and to everything still ahead. Cheers!"
positive.expected_behavior: Calls count_text with the speech. Reports 145 words in 10 sentences, a speaking time of 58 sec at 150 words per minute, and a reading time of 37 sec at 238 words per minute, with Flesch reading ease 79.5 (Fairly easy).

positive.description: Abstract over a 40-60 word limit, with where to cut
positive.prompt: My abstract must be 40 to 60 words. Is this OK, and where should I cut? "This study examines how short daily walks affect the mood of office workers. Over eight weeks, 120 adults in three cities took a 15-minute walk after lunch, while a control group stayed at their desks. Walkers reported higher energy and lower stress on most days, and the effect was strongest in the first month. We discuss practical ways for employers to support movement during the workday and outline questions for future research."
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_length_limits with min_words 40 and max_words 60. Reports 72 words, over by 12, and says to cut after "...We discuss practical ways for employers" (keeps 60 words). The widget shows a red word-target bar with the cut point.

positive.description: SMS segment count with Unicode characters
positive.prompt: How many SMS messages will this be? "Hi Anna – your appointment with Dr. Lee is confirmed for Tue 14 Oct at 14:00. Reply “YES” to confirm or call 020 7946 0958 to change it. See you soon!"
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_length_limits with platforms sms. Reports 150 UCS-2 characters, sent as 3 messages, because the en dash and curly quotes (– “ ”) force Unicode with a 70-character limit, and notes that replacing them with plain characters would allow 160 characters (1 message).

negative.description: Rewriting is out of scope. Expected: the tools are not called; the assistant shortens the paragraph itself without this plugin.
negative.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph to be shorter: Our team has been working very hard over the last several months to build something that we think you will really love.

negative.description: Word definitions are out of scope. Expected: the tools are not called; the assistant explains the meaning of the word directly.
Counting non-text things is out of scope. Expected: the tools are not called; the assistant answers the calorie question without this plugin.
negative.prompt: Count the calories in my lunch: a turkey sandwich, an apple, and a latte.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: exact word, character, sentence, paragraph, and unique-word counts; essay exclusions for citations, quotes, headings, and reference lists; reading and speaking time; English readability; keyword density; long-sentence warnings; X weighted counting, Threads, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Instagram, SEO title, meta description, and SMS segment checks with cut points.

pl-PL.subtitle: Dokładna liczba słów i znaków
pl-PL.description: Zovo Word Counter dokładnie liczy słowa, znaki (ze spacjami i bez), zdania, akapity i unikalne słowa w tekście wklejonym do czatu. Potrafi pominąć przypisy w stylu APA i MLA, cytaty, nagłówki i bibliografię, poda czas czytania i wygłaszania, słowa kluczowe oraz zbyt długie zdania. Sprawdza też limity X (Twitter), Threads, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Instagram, tytułu SEO, meta description i SMS, pokazując, gdzie skrócić tekst. Tekst jest przetwarzany tylko w pamięci i nie jest zapisywany.

de-DE.subtitle: Exakte Wort- & Zeichenzahl
de-DE.description: Zovo Word Counter zählt Wörter, Zeichen mit und ohne Leerzeichen, Sätze, Absätze und eindeutige Wörter exakt. Für Hausarbeiten lassen sich Zitate im APA- oder MLA-Stil, wörtliche Zitate, Überschriften und das Literaturverzeichnis ausschließen. Dazu kommen Lese- und Sprechzeit, Schlüsselwörter und Hinweise auf zu lange Sätze. Außerdem prüft es die Limits von X (Twitter), Threads, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Instagram, SEO-Titel, Meta-Description und SMS und zeigt, wo gekürzt werden muss. Der Text wird nur im Arbeitsspeicher verarbeitet und nicht gespeichert.

es-ES.subtitle: Cuenta exacta de palabras
es-ES.description: Zovo Word Counter cuenta con exactitud palabras, caracteres con y sin espacios, oraciones, párrafos y palabras únicas. Para trabajos académicos puede excluir citas APA y MLA, pasajes entre comillas, títulos y la bibliografía. También calcula el tiempo de lectura y de exposición, las palabras clave y las oraciones demasiado largas, y comprueba los límites de X (Twitter), Threads, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Instagram, título SEO, meta descripción y SMS, indicando dónde recortar. El texto se procesa solo en memoria y no se guarda.

fr-FR.subtitle: Comptage exact des mots
fr-FR.description: Zovo Word Counter compte exactement les mots, les caractères avec et sans espaces, les phrases, les paragraphes et les mots uniques. Pour les devoirs, il peut exclure les citations APA et MLA, les passages entre guillemets, les titres et la bibliographie. Il indique aussi le temps de lecture et de parole, les mots-clés et les phrases trop longues, et vérifie les limites de X (Twitter), Threads, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Instagram, du titre SEO, de la meta description et des SMS, avec l'endroit où couper. Le texte est traité uniquement en mémoire et n'est pas conservé.

ja-JP.subtitle: 正確な単語数・文字数カウント
ja-JP.description: Zovo Word Counter は、チャットに貼り付けた文章の単語数、文字数（スペースあり・なし）、文数、段落数、ユニーク単語数を正確に数えます。日本語・中国語・タイ語は辞書ベースで単語に分割し、CJK 文字数も表示します。レポート用に APA・MLA 形式の引用、引用文、見出し、参考文献を除外でき、読了時間や発話時間、キーワード、長すぎる文も確認できます。X（Twitter）、Threads、Bluesky、LinkedIn、Instagram、SEO タイトル、メタディスクリプション、SMS の文字数制限もチェックし、どこで区切ればよいかを示します。テキストはメモリ上でのみ処理され、保存されません。

pt-BR.subtitle: Contagem exata de palavras
pt-BR.description: O Zovo Word Counter conta com exatidão palavras, caracteres com e sem espaços, frases, parágrafos e palavras únicas. Para trabalhos acadêmicos, pode excluir citações APA e MLA, trechos entre aspas, títulos e as referências. Também mostra o tempo de leitura e de fala, palavras-chave e frases longas demais, e verifica os limites do X (Twitter), Threads, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Instagram, título SEO, meta description e SMS, indicando onde cortar. O texto é processado apenas na memória e não é armazenado.
